messages:
anna: quick heads-up — on the AWQ vs FP8 bakeoff for the legalqa suite I hit a reproducible formatting regression when changing batch_shape from (1,16) -> (8,2). repro below. anna: repro script: ``` python -m tests.run_batch --model awq-int8-candidate --input-file samples/legalqa-prompts.json --batch-shape "8,2" --seed 42 ``` mike: do you have the model config and tokenizer seed? saw formatting drift earlier when tokenizer pad token was different anna: tokenizer is t5-tokenizer v2, pad=0. model config: quant_profile=awq-int8, shared_kv_cache=true. paste sample output: ``` Q: What's the statute of limitations? A: The statute is three years. --- Q: Provide the legal reasoning. A:

According to sec 12.1 ...

``` mike: that tag is the formatting bug — model is inserting raw tags for mid/long answers raj: could be kv-cache + batch packing interaction. when shared_kv_cache=true and batch_shape packs different prefix lengths we observed token-alignment shifts (esp around multi-sentence answers). elena: I ran a quick sweep: with shared_kv_cache=false the html tags disappear, but tail latency +12%. reproducible across seeds and on both AWQ-int8 and GPTQ-fp8 candidates. quant-bot: metric snapshot — perplexity delta +0.4; exact-match -2.3% on legalqa dev; hallucination rate +1.8% (markup insertions). anna: proposed next steps: 1) reproduce with GPTQ-fp8 candidate to check quant backend dependence 2) test pack boundary by shuffling prefix lengths and forcing explicit pad tokens 3) run canary with fallback policy to fp8 if EM drops >1.5% mike: can someone bisect layer-wise? I can run a layer-ablation quantization job tonight (freeze layers high->low). raj: I'll add a regression check to onboarding harness: fail if any generated output contains raw '' unless the prompt explicitly requested html. also test with shared_kv_cache toggled. elena: assigning @raj and @mike to triage, @anna to validation. I'll create a canary rollout 50/50 with automatic fallback. deploybot: canary created: build=awq-int8-candidate-2026-03-20-42; route=/models/legalqa/canary; fallback=fp8-gptq-stable anna: thanks — I'll attach logs and a minimal reproducer to the ticket. please paste quick reproducer outputs here if you run small sweeps :thumbsup:
